topic: init/architecture: modules in node_modules, not vendored
decision: Quorum modules live in node_modules (@balpal4495/quorum), not copied into host repos. init writes only quorum/CLAUDE.md, quorum/AGENTS.md, quorum/SETUP.md as documentation. evals stay in the package.
key_insight: Vendoring solved AI visibility of module source, but the CLI now handles the main interaction surface. Docs give agents what they need; source in node_modules gives teams clean npm update upgrades.
rejected_reason: Vendoring blocked upgrades — no quorum upgrade command, users stuck on installed version
Symlinks are fragile across platforms and confuse many tools
